title: Who may give the separate-context approval of an assembled Spec?
question: Who may give the separate-context approval of an assembled Spec?
answer: SCR-3: The Director owns the separate-context approval of a Spec a Dispatcher carries. The Dispatcher does the prior whole-Spec self-QA but may not give the Director approval; agents that implemented Tasks in the candidate are also ineligible.
